strategy: Recycle into fresh backend model context before native compaction; keep logical user task identity
budget_rule: current_context_upper_bound + next_input_upper_bound + all_growth_reservation < recycle_at <= effective_compaction_limit - safety_margin
measurement: Verified context upper bound bound to current context, generation and observation sequence; cumulative usage and cached token totals are not context occupancy
control: Gate must own every provider step; bounded autonomous growth until the next gate. Checking only turn/start is insufficient.
handover: No in-flight work; preserve exact capsule state; verify fresh empty-history context, policy digest, capsule digest, old-state digest and fresh budget before switch
unknown: Block when limits, measurements, source binding or growth bounds are unavailable; no optimistic fallback
compaction_event: Treat observed native compaction as invariant violation requiring reconciliation, not the normal path
